Select canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units for activity rows in assay CHEMBL1614174. Join molecule_dictionary to activities on molregno, join compound_structures on molregno as an inner join, join assays on assay_id. Filter by assays.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1614174', activities.standard_value IS NOT NULL, activities.standard_relation = '='. Keep every qualifying activity row; do not use DISTINCT. Sort by canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units.
